task.description: Applied REQ-237's .zig provenance-marking convention (marker text and structural placement rule in §2, incl. the 2026-09-05 lib/letflow/design/ chunking amendment and the ISS-0510 YAML comment-line/sequence-item amendment) to chunk 239-design-f: the 13 files req083-task-routes-read.md through req171-wasm-host-api-read.md under lib/letflow/design/ (sparse numbering req083..req171). For every .zig source-path citation, inserted the literal line 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' immediately above the smallest enclosing citation unit (single line/list item, whole paragraph, whole table, heading, or blockquote line prefixed with '> ' to preserve blockquote syntax) without altering any citation text. No file outside this chunk's 13-file list was touched.

result.note: Before-state (confirmed zero pre-existing markers on all 13 files): grep -c '\.zig' per file -- req083=12, req085=6, req109=24, req135=39, req137=17, req148=2, req151=2, req152=1, req154=1, req157=5, req158=8, req163=2, req171=1; sum=120. After-state: same per-file counts, sum=120 -- zero citation text altered or removed, only marker lines added. Markers inserted per file: req083=10, req085=5, req109=20, req135=11, req137=7, req148=2, req151=2, req152=1, req154=1, req157=4, req158=5, req163=2, req171=1; total=71 new PROVENANCE lines across the chunk. Sample-diffed all 13 files' full diffs (well over the 10-citation/5-file minimum) -- every citation's original path text is byte-identical before/after, only a new marker line was added above each unit; table units got one marker above the header row (never per-row), each bullet/list item got its own marker (never merged), and one blockquote citation (req151-lua-sandbox.md) got a '> '-prefixed marker line to keep it inside the blockquote rather than breaking Markdown syntax. Divergence-note check: `grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'` before and after this chunk's edits -- only lib/letflow/design/req109-variable-schemas.md carries any such lines (2, at originally 360/709, now shifted to 367/723 purely from markers inserted earlier in that same file); text of both lines is byte-identical before/after. Confirmed via `git diff --stat` that CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and every lib/letflow/design/ file outside this chunk's 13-file list are untouched (empty diff when excluding the 13 files).
